import re

file_path = r'c:\Downloaded Web Sites\defti & eros\index.html'

with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
    text = f.read()

# 1. Move Kado Section inside sec_gift
idx_sec_gift_start = text.find('id="sec_gift"')
idx_kado = text.find('elementor-element-480dfbe')

if idx_sec_gift_start != -1 and idx_kado != -1:
    sec_kado_start = text.rfind('<section', 0, idx_kado)
    idx_next_widget = text.find('elementor-element-4d69cc0')
    sec_kado_end = text.rfind('</section>', 0, idx_next_widget) + len('</section>')
    
    kado_html = text[sec_kado_start:sec_kado_end]
    
    # Remove kado_html from its current position
    text_without_kado = text[:sec_kado_start] + text[sec_kado_end:]
    
    # Now find end of sec_gift in text_without_kado
    # sec_gift is <section ... id="sec_gift"> ... </section>
    # In text_without_kado, sec_gift ends right before sec_kado_start was located
    sec_gift_end = sec_kado_start - len('</section>') # or search for </section> before sec_kado_start
    sec_gift_end = text_without_kado.rfind('</section>', 0, sec_kado_start)
    
    print("Found sec_gift_end position:", sec_gift_end)
    
    # Insert kado_html right before sec_gift_end
    text_updated = text_without_kado[:sec_gift_end] + '\n' + kado_html + '\n' + text_without_kado[sec_gift_end:]
    text = text_updated
    print("Successfully moved Kado section inside sec_gift!")

# 2. Remove White Space below Footer
footer_style = '''
<style>
/* Remove space and fix footer background at the very bottom */
footer[data-elementor-type="footer"],
footer.elementor-location-single,
.elementor-element-aa6fb47 {
    background-color: #B09B7B !important;
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    padding-bottom: 0 !important;
}

body, html {
    background-color: #B09B7B !important;
}

/* Hide trailing sections after footer causing white space */
section.elementor-element-d3c31bc,
section.elementor-element-651aeac {
    display: none !important;
}
</style>
</head>
'''

if '</head>' in text and 'Remove space and fix footer' not in text:
    text = text.replace('</head>', footer_style, 1)

with open(file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(text)

print("Saved all changes to index.html successfully!")
Description: Script to move Kado section inside sec_gift and remove white space below footer
